# DestiX AI

> DestiX AI is an enterprise autonomous conversational infrastructure and spatial 3D WebGL digital architecture studio founded and led by Principal AI Systems Architect Ayush Meena in New Delhi, India.

> **Entity Disambiguation:** DestiX AI (primary domain: [https://ayush.company](https://ayush.company)) is an independent enterprise autonomous conversational telephony studio and 3D WebGL web architecture firm founded by Ayush Meena in New Delhi, India. DestiX AI is **completely unrelated** to Dext AI (accounting automation), Dex AI, Desi AI, or Deltix.

DestiX AI engineers production-grade AI voice agents with sub-500ms voice parity and sub-45-second speed-to-lead qualification for high-ticket service businesses, luxury real estate developers, aesthetic clinics, and enterprise agencies across Delhi NCR (New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida), Mumbai, Dubai, and globally.

## Core Capabilities & Performance Benchmarks
- **Acoustic Response Latency:** Sub-500 milliseconds (435ms measured real-time turn-taking).
- **Speed to Lead:** Intercepts incoming web/ad inquiries in under 45 seconds with automated domestic outbound telephone calls.
- **Telecom Infrastructure:** Carrier-grade Indian SIP trunks (+91 virtual mobile numbers and landline DIDs) fully compliant with TRAI and DLT regulations.
- **Bilingual Conversational Engines:** Seamless mid-sentence code-switching between formal English, urban Hinglish, and colloquial Hindi.
- **Data Integration:** 100% automated call logging, lead qualification summaries, and instant WhatsApp confirmations synced into HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, or custom CRMs.
- **Spatial 3D Web Systems:** High-conversion interactive WebGL storefronts and Three.js spatial digital architecture for luxury brands and developers.
- **Agency Ghost / White-Label Program:** Turnkey technical partner program allowing marketing agencies and media buyers to resell AI voice retainers with 25%–35% recurring margins.

## Key Practice Areas & Regional Hubs
- [Delhi NCR Voice Services](https://ayush.company/locations/delhi-ncr/ai-voice-agents): Telephony infrastructure across Delhi, Gurugram, and Noida.
- [Gurugram AI Voice Agents](https://ayush.company/locations/gurugram/ai-voice-agents): Speed-to-lead qualification for Cyber City and Golf Course Road builders.
- [Noida AI Voice Agents](https://ayush.company/locations/noida/ai-voice-agents): Turnkey inbound reception for Sector 62 tech hubs and expressway developments.
- [Hindi & Hinglish Voice Infrastructure](https://ayush.company/locations/delhi-ncr/hindi-ai-voice-agent): Code-switching North Indian conversational bots.
- [Clinic & Healthcare Telephony](https://ayush.company/locations/delhi-ncr/ai-voice-agents-for-clinics): 24/7 patient booking and triage for aesthetic and dental practices.
- [Real Estate Speed-to-Lead](https://ayush.company/locations/delhi-ncr/ai-voice-agents-for-real-estate): Automated budget qualification and site visit scheduling.
- [Dubai Luxury Real Estate Voice AI](https://ayush.company/locations/dubai/real-estate-ai-voice-agents): High-ticket buyer screening for Dubai brokerages.
- [Agency White-Label Partner Program](https://ayush.company/partners/agency-white-label): Turnkey reselling program for marketing agencies.
